When that happens, timeouts bypass the intended manual-review fallback and leave tickets without a routing label entirely. I have not yet filed this finding in the launch ticket. This directly impacts the rollout configuration — if production traffic generates more than 2 concurrent inference requests, we risk tickets going unrouted, which is worse than the current manual process. This needs to be addressed before I can confirm the flag is safe to enable for any customer group on Tuesday.
